# SEO Writing Checklist

- Put the primary keyword at the start of the title tag; keep total title length under 60 characters.
- Write a meta description (155–160 characters) with a clear CTA that includes the primary keyword.
- Use a logical H1–H3 hierarchy; work related keywords and entities into headings.
- Create short, readable URLs that include the target keyword (e.g., `/blog/seo-guide/`).
- Include the primary keyword within the first 100 words of body copy.
- Add 5–10 internal links per page using keyword-rich anchor text.
- Compress images and provide descriptive, keyword-relevant `alt` text.
- Add a table of contents and visual breaks for scannability.
- Use 5+ supportive visuals (charts/graphs/infographics), AI-assisted if helpful.
- Match or slightly exceed the word count of top-ranking competitor pages.
- Keep pages loading under ~3 seconds; prioritize mobile-first performance.
